infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SPILS uses your camera to photograph perfume bottles. For example, you can snap a picture of a bottle's label to automatically fill in its name, brand, and notes, or attach the photo to a journal entry, collection bottle, or Lab mood board.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SPILS accesses your photo library so you can pick existing photos of your perfume bottles. For example, you can select a bottle photo to display on a collection or journal entry, or add images to a Lab formula mood board.
